book.name: Mbouŋ to Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content.text: O Yoova, yei lolomai pa tamtoghon tipait izamai malep.
Tipait yom izam pa tapirim ve poia tiom, ghoro poia.
Pasa, lolom ineep tuŋia ila to tamtoghon tiom ve uluul di, ve utaghon saveeŋ mbuaaŋ tiom irau sawa isob.
Tovenen upatooŋ tapirim, ve uul ghei.
Pa vene, ndug ndug tiveleg ghom, ve tisaav payei tighaze:
“Aa, Maaron tiam ineep sine?”
Eemoghon yei niwatag: Maaron tiei, ye ineep izi sambam.
Ve sa ŋgar to ye ighaze ighami, nene ighami moghon.
Ndug ndug tighagharaat maaron todi pa silva ve gol.
Maaron kaaromŋa tonowen, tamtoghon tigharaat di pa nimadi. Mbaŋ 19:26; Syg 9:20
Yes ledi avodi. Eemoghon tisavsaav maau.
Ve ledi matadi. Eemoghon tighita ndug maau.
Yes ledi taliŋadi. Eemoghon tilooŋ saveeŋ maau.
Ve ledi uzudi. Eemoghon tiyaaz mbeb eta vuzi maau.
Yes ledi aghedi. Eemoghon irau tilaagh maau.
Ve ledi nimadi. Eemoghon irau tikis mbeb eta ve tiyamaana ne maau.
Onoon kat, saveeŋ ma taŋiiz eta ivot pa avodi maau. Mbo 135:15+; 1Kor 12:2
Tamtoghon to tighagharaat maaron kaaromŋa tovene ve tinumeer di, yes tisob tinimale maaron todi tonowen. Tirau mbeb eta maau.
Yam ival tiina to Israel, anumeer Yoova.
Pasa, ye to Volaaŋa tiam, ve inim sigeu payam.
Ve yam to watooŋrau to avot ila to Aron ne paam, anumeer Yoova!
Pasa, ye to Volaaŋa tiam, ve inim sigeu payam.
Tovenen yam to amatughez pa Yoova ve ataghon ŋgar toni, yam asob anumeera.
Pasa, ye to Volaaŋa tiam, ve inim sigeu payam.
Yoova mata iŋgalŋgal ghei. Ve ye pale ighur poia toni iza tiei.
Pale ighur poia toni iza to yes to watooŋrau to tivot ila to Aron.
Ve ighur poia toni iza to ival tiina to Israel paam.
Tovenen yes to timatughez pani ve titaghon ŋgar toni, ye pale ighur poia toni iza to yes tisob.
Yes to ledi izadi maau, ve yes to izadi tintina ne paam.
Yoova pale igham gham toman papaghu tiam amasa anim naol.
Yoova to ighur sambam ve taan.
Ye pale ighur poia toni iza tiam.
Sambam, nene Yoova ndug toni.
Ve taan, nene ye igham pa iit tamtoghon pa taneep ila.
Yes to timaat ve tizila ndug to mateeŋa, eta iyou oroor maau. Neneeŋadi moghon.
Irau tipait Yoova muul maau.
Eemoghon iit to taneep mataad iyaryaar, ghoro lolood poia pa Yoova, ve tapaiti pa poia toni.
To aazne, ve itaghoni taghoni gha ila.
Aleluia, tapait Yoova!
